props.doc:
Three real SOC playbooks, as definitions the engine executes.

They exist to prove the architecture rather than to look good in a
screenshot: each one exercises enrichment, a loop, an AI step, a risk
decision, a human approval and a compensating action. If any of those is
wrong, one of these three fails.
props.name: demonstration_playbooks

props.code:
ioc_investigation = {
    "key": "ioc.investigation",
    "name": "IOC Investigation",
    "description": "Enrich one indicator across every configured intel source, score it, and record the result on the incident.",
    "technique_ids": [],
    "definition": {
        "start": "n_start",
        "variables": [
            {"name": "verdicts", "type": "array", "scope": "execution", "initial": []},
            {"name": "risk_score", "type": "number", "scope": "execution", "initial": 0},
        ],
        "nodes": {
            "n_start": {"kind": "start", "next": "n_type"},
            "n_type": {"kind": "command", "command": "ioc.detect_type",
                       "inputs": {"value": "{{ inputs.indicator }}"},
                       "output_var": "ioc", "next": "n_branch"},
            "n_branch": {"kind": "switch", "subject": "{{ ioc.type }}",
                         "cases": {"ipv4": "n_ip", "ipv6": "n_ip",
                                   "domain": "n_domain", "url": "n_domain",
                                   "sha256": "n_file", "md5": "n_file",
                                   "sha1": "n_file"},
                         "default": "n_unknown"},
            "n_ip": {"kind": "parallel",
                     "branches": ["n_vt_ip", "n_abuse", "n_otx_ip"],
                     "join": "all", "next": "n_misp"},
            "n_vt_ip": {"kind": "command", "command": "virustotal.ip_report",
                        "inputs": {"ip": "{{ inputs.indicator }}"},
                        "output_var": "vt",
                        "retry": {"max": 2, "backoff": "exponential"},
                        "timeout_ms": 20000, "on_error": "n_note_gap"},
            "n_abuse": {"kind": "command", "command": "abuseipdb.check",
                        "inputs": {"ip": "{{ inputs.indicator }}"},
                        "output_var": "abuse", "on_error": "n_note_gap"},
            "n_otx_ip": {"kind": "command", "command": "otx.indicator",
                         "inputs": {"kind": "IPv4",
                                    "value": "{{ inputs.indicator }}"},
                         "output_var": "otx", "on_error": "n_note_gap"},
            "n_domain": {"kind": "command", "command": "virustotal.domain_report",
                         "inputs": {"domain": "{{ inputs.indicator }}"},
                         "output_var": "vt", "next": "n_misp"},
            "n_file": {"kind": "command", "command": "virustotal.file_report",
                       "inputs": {"hash": "{{ inputs.indicator }}"},
                       "output_var": "vt", "next": "n_misp"},
            "n_unknown": {"kind": "incident_update",
                          "inputs": {"note": "Indicator type could not be determined: {{ inputs.indicator | defang }}"},
                          "next": "n_end"},
            "n_misp": {"kind": "command", "command": "misp.search_attribute",
                       "inputs": {"value": "{{ inputs.indicator }}"},
                       "output_var": "misp", "on_error": "n_note_gap",
                       "next": "n_collect"},
            "n_note_gap": {"kind": "incident_update",
                           "inputs": {"note": "An intelligence source did not answer; the score below is from the sources that did."},
                           "next": "n_collect"},
            "n_collect": {"kind": "transform",
                          "inputs": {"verdicts": [
                              {"provider": "virustotal", "score": "{{ vt.malicious | default(0) }}"},
                              {"provider": "abuseipdb", "score": "{{ abuse.abuse_confidence | default(0) }}"},
                              {"provider": "otx", "score": "{{ otx.pulse_count | default(0) }}"},
                              {"provider": "misp", "score": "{{ misp.hits | default(0) }}"}]},
                          "output_var": "verdicts", "next": "n_score"},
            "n_score": {"kind": "command", "command": "intel.score",
                        "inputs": {"verdicts": "{{ verdicts }}"},
                        "output_var": "scored", "next": "n_ai"},
            "n_ai": {"kind": "ai", "action": "analyze", "role": "fast",
                     "inputs": {"subject": "indicator",
                                "evidence": "{{ verdicts | json }}"},
                     "output_var": "analysis", "on_error": "n_record",
                     "next": "n_record"},
            "n_record": {"kind": "incident_update",
                         "inputs": {"indicator": "{{ inputs.indicator }}",
                                    "verdict": "{{ scored.verdict }}",
                                    "score": "{{ scored.score }}",
                                    "note": "{{ analysis.summary | default('No AI analysis available.') }}"},
                         "next": "n_end"},
            "n_end": {"kind": "end", "outcome": "succeeded"},
        },
    },
}

suspicious_endpoint = {
    "key": "endpoint.suspicious",
    "name": "Suspicious Endpoint",
    "description": "Investigate an endpoint alert, decide risk, and contain with human approval.",
    "technique_ids": ["T1059", "T1055"],
    "definition": {
        "start": "n_start",
        "variables": [{"name": "risk", "type": "number", "scope": "execution",
                       "initial": 0}],
        "nodes": {
            "n_start": {"kind": "start", "next": "n_host"},
            "n_host": {"kind": "command", "command": "crowdstrike.find_host",
                       "inputs": {"hostname": "{{ incident.entities[0].hostname }}"},
                       "output_var": "found", "on_error": "n_manual",
                       "next": "n_detail"},
            "n_detail": {"kind": "command", "command": "crowdstrike.get_host",
                         "inputs": {"device_id": "{{ found.device_ids | first }}"},
                         "output_var": "host", "next": "n_recent"},
            "n_recent": {"kind": "command",
                         "command": "crowdstrike.recent_detections",
                         "inputs": {"device_id": "{{ found.device_ids | first }}"},
                         "output_var": "recent", "next": "n_related"},
            "n_related": {"kind": "command", "command": "sentinel.run_query",
                          "inputs": {"query": "SecurityEvent | where Computer == @host | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) | summarize count() by EventID",
                                     "timespan": "P1D"},
                          "output_var": "siem", "on_error": "n_ai",
                          "next": "n_ai"},
            "n_ai": {"kind": "ai", "action": "investigate", "role": "investigation",
                     "inputs": {"entity": "{{ host.hostname }}",
                                "detections": "{{ recent.detection_ids | json }}",
                                "siem": "{{ siem.rows | json }}"},
                     "output_var": "analysis", "next": "n_decide"},
            "n_decide": {"kind": "condition",
                         "when": [{"if": "analysis.risk_score >= 70",
                                   "then": "n_approve"}],
                         "else": "n_close"},
            "n_approve": {"kind": "approval",
                          "action_key": "response.isolate",
                          "risk_level": "high",
                          "summary": "Isolate {{ host.hostname }} - {{ analysis.headline }}",
                          "timeout_s": 1800,
                          "on_approve": "n_isolate",
                          "on_reject": "n_close",
                          "on_timeout": "n_escalate"},
            "n_isolate": {"kind": "command",
                          "command": "crowdstrike.isolate_host",
                          "inputs": {"device_id": "{{ found.device_ids | first }}"},
                          "compensation": "n_release",
                          "retry": {"max": 2, "backoff": "exponential"},
                          "on_error": "n_fallback", "next": "n_report"},
            "n_release": {"kind": "command",
                          "command": "crowdstrike.release_host",
                          "inputs": {"device_id": "{{ found.device_ids | first }}"},
                          "next": "n_report"},
            "n_fallback": {"kind": "notification",
                           "inputs": {"channel": "soc-oncall",
                                      "message": "Isolation of {{ host.hostname }} FAILED after retries. Attempt secondary containment."},
                           "next": "n_secondary"},
            "n_secondary": {"kind": "task",
                            "inputs": {"title": "Manually contain {{ host.hostname }}",
                                       "assignee_role": "Analyst"},
                            "next": "n_report"},
            "n_escalate": {"kind": "notification",
                           "inputs": {"channel": "soc-lead",
                                      "message": "Isolation approval for {{ host.hostname }} timed out. Escalating."},
                           "next": "n_report"},
            "n_close": {"kind": "incident_update",
                        "inputs": {"status": "investigating",
                                   "note": "{{ analysis.summary }}"},
                        "next": "n_end"},
            "n_manual": {"kind": "task",
                         "inputs": {"title": "Host not found in EDR - investigate manually"},
                         "next": "n_end"},
            "n_report": {"kind": "ai", "action": "summarize", "role": "reasoning",
                         "inputs": {"incident": "{{ incident.id }}"},
                         "output_var": "report", "next": "n_end"},
            "n_end": {"kind": "end", "outcome": "succeeded"},
        },
    },
}

phishing = {
    "key": "email.phishing",
    "name": "Phishing Investigation",
    "description": "Analyse a reported message, determine maliciousness, find every recipient, and respond with approval.",
    "technique_ids": ["T1566.001", "T1566.002"],
    "definition": {
        "start": "n_start",
        "variables": [
            {"name": "url_verdicts", "type": "array", "scope": "execution",
             "initial": []},
        ],
        "nodes": {
            "n_start": {"kind": "start", "next": "n_extract"},
            "n_extract": {"kind": "command", "command": "ioc.extract",
                          "inputs": {"text": "{{ inputs.raw_email }}"},
                          "output_var": "iocs", "next": "n_ai_extract"},
            "n_ai_extract": {"kind": "ai", "action": "extract", "role": "fast",
                             "inputs": {"text": "{{ inputs.raw_email }}"},
                             "output_var": "ai_iocs",
                             "on_error": "n_loop", "next": "n_loop"},
            "n_loop": {"kind": "for_each", "items": "{{ iocs.indicators }}",
                       "as": "ioc", "max_iterations": 100,
                       "body": "n_sub", "next": "n_ai_verdict"},
            "n_sub": {"kind": "sub_playbook", "playbook": "ioc.investigation",
                      "inputs": {"indicator": "{{ ioc.value }}"},
                      "output_var": "sub", "on_error": "n_loop"},
            "n_ai_verdict": {"kind": "ai", "action": "classify", "role": "reasoning",
                             "inputs": {"subject": "email",
                                        "headers": "{{ inputs.headers | json }}",
                                        "body": "{{ inputs.body }}",
                                        "indicator_findings": "{{ url_verdicts | json }}"},
                             "output_var": "verdict", "next": "n_malicious"},
            "n_malicious": {"kind": "condition",
                            "when": [{"if": "verdict.classification == 'malicious'",
                                      "then": "n_recipients"}],
                            "else": "n_close"},
            "n_recipients": {"kind": "command", "command": "sentinel.run_query",
                             "inputs": {"query": "EmailEvents | where SenderFromAddress == @sender | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | project RecipientEmailAddress, DeliveryAction",
                                        "timespan": "P7D"},
                             "output_var": "recipients",
                             "on_error": "n_recommend", "next": "n_recommend"},
            "n_recommend": {"kind": "ai", "action": "recommend", "role": "reasoning",
                            "inputs": {"incident": "{{ incident.id }}",
                                       "recipients": "{{ recipients.rows | json }}"},
                            "output_var": "plan", "next": "n_approve"},
            "n_approve": {"kind": "approval", "action_key": "response.delete_mail",
                          "risk_level": "high",
                          "summary": "Purge {{ recipients.row_count }} messages and block sender {{ inputs.sender | defang }}",
                          "timeout_s": 3600,
                          "on_approve": "n_respond", "on_reject": "n_close",
                          "on_timeout": "n_escalate"},
            "n_respond": {"kind": "parallel",
                          "branches": ["n_block_sender", "n_add_misp"],
                          "join": "all", "next": "n_notify"},
            "n_block_sender": {"kind": "task",
                               "inputs": {"title": "Block sender {{ inputs.sender }} at the mail gateway"}},
            "n_add_misp": {"kind": "command", "command": "misp.add_attribute",
                           "inputs": {"event_id": "{{ inputs.misp_event_id }}",
                                      "type": "email-src",
                                      "value": "{{ inputs.sender }}"},
                           "on_error": "n_notify"},
            "n_notify": {"kind": "notification",
                         "inputs": {"channel": "affected-users",
                                    "message": "A phishing message was removed from your mailbox."},
                         "next": "n_end"},
            "n_escalate": {"kind": "notification",
                           "inputs": {"channel": "soc-lead",
                                      "message": "Phishing response approval timed out."},
                           "next": "n_end"},
            "n_close": {"kind": "incident_update",
                        "inputs": {"status": "closed",
                                   "resolution": "false_positive",
                                   "note": "{{ verdict.rationale }}"},
                        "next": "n_end"},
            "n_end": {"kind": "end", "outcome": "succeeded"},
        },
    },
}

return [ioc_investigation, suspicious_endpoint, phishing]
